prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage. Bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design.
2. One dominant flat block-colour background for the whole shot: deep magenta. Never a rainbow, never a gradient.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Never a recognisable person's face.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the background's contrasting colour. Real paper texture, print dots, small tape pieces.
5. Consistent upper-left light. Small paper-layer shadows only.
6. Everything is flat matte printed paper. No glow, no neon, no bloom, no halos, no luminous edges. Nothing emits light. Not glossy 3D. Not live action.
7. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif, black or cream, printed on paper chips, large, safe margins. English spelling and letterforms accurate and stable. Only the headline text in the copy list, nothing else.
8. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window. One strongest visual focus at a time. No camera shake. Movement starts on the first frame; a small loop continues at the end. No empty frames.
9. Numbers, when specified, are printed complete from their first visible frame. Never counting up, never morphing, never redrawn.
10. No brands, logos, watermarks, or text beyond the copy list.
11. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
12. Identity anchor: rough white torn-paper edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: deep magenta.
Subjects: the four buildings; a rising paper bar.
Opens on the four buildings, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The buildings compress into one rising paper bar that climbs and locks in place.
Ends holding on the rising bar.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "$8.1M G&A".

COPY LIST: "$8.1M G&A". Exact strings; nothing else appears in frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "General and administrative costs rose three point four million to eight point one million in the first half.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a modern editorial paper collage in a refined 2D motion design style. The scene opens on <Picture 1>, featuring a deep magenta flat block-color background with a matte paper texture. Four black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts of neoclassical buildings are arranged around a central cream-colored paper strip; each cutout has rough white torn-paper edges and casts a small, subtle shadow falling to the bottom-right from a consistent upper-left light source. On the first frame, the narrator (S1), a male with a warm, clear, and natural timbre and a brisk speaking rate, begins speaking: <d>[English] General and administrative costs rose three point four million to eight point one million in the first half.</d> Simultaneously, the four building cutouts and the central strip rapidly compress and merge toward the center of the frame with a slight overshoot, transforming into a single vertical cream-colored paper bar that rises upward and locks firmly in place. As the bar settles, a rectangular cream paper chip appears beside it, featuring the headline "$8.1M G&A" printed in a large, extra-bold black sans-serif typeface. The text is clean, legible, and stable with safe margins. The camera remains in a Static Shot for the duration. The video ends with the rising bar and the "$8.1M G&A" text held steady, with a very subtle, slow-pulsing scale loop of the paper elements to maintain visual energy. All elements remain flat matte printed paper with no glow, neon, or 3D gloss.

overall_soundscape: A clean, professional voiceover is accompanied by diegetic foley sounds of paper. Crisp "slap" sounds occur as the buildings compress and a tactile "sticky" tape sound triggers when the vertical bar and text chip lock into their final positions.
